fields.Name: Chapter Membership Distribution
fields.Description: Skip analytics conversation from the More Cheese suite

fields.Message: Show me a chart displaying the number of members in each chapter. When I click on a chapter, show me who the members are. [NO CHAT]

Here you go, your Chapter Membership Distribution & Roster explorer is ready with data from Committees, Memberships, and Member Profiles. It features summary KPI metrics and an interactive bar chart of active member counts by chapter that instantly filters the detailed member roster below. You can search, filter by role or status, export the roster to CSV, and click any member row to open their full profile record.
